Subject: Your divorce by mutual consent matter - Petition No. 452/2023

Dear Ms. Shinde,

Thank you for meeting us on 14/09/2023 about your dispute with Simran Natarajan. As we understand it, the spouses agree on a single payment instead of maintenance.

Our advice is to record the one-time alimony settlement in the consent terms. Please collect income tax returns and the draft consent terms and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs 60,30,000.

Regards,
Adv. Sharmila Venkatesan
